SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_EXISTS: The user already has a current or pending subscription.
SUBSCRIPTION_RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND: The subscription reservation was not found.
SUBSCRIPTION_RESERVATION_MISMATCH: The PayPal subscription does not match the requested reservation.
SUBSCRIPTION_PAYPAL_NOT_APPROVED: The subscription has not yet been approved in PayPal.
SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_PERIOD_UNAVAILABLE: The coverage period of the confirmed payment could not be determined.
SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The billing information does not match the processed payment.
SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_AMOUNT_INVALID: The confirmed payment amount is invalid.
SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_PLAN_AMOUNT_MISMATC: The payment does not match the BiblioLink Pro plan amount.
SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLATION_NOT_FOUND: The subscription associated with the cancellation was not found.
SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_RESERVATION_INVALID: The notification does not contain a valid reservation reference.
SUBSCRIPTION_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH: The subscription does not belong to the authenticated user.
SUBSCRIPTION_RESERVATION_ALREADY_LINKED: The reservation is already linked to another subscription.

SUBSCRIPTION_CHECKOUT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: The subscription does not contain a valid checkout reference.
SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER_STATUS_UNKNOWN: The provider returned an unknown subscription status.

SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION_FAILED: The payment could not be confirmed.
SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED: The payment provider webhook is not configured.
SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_UNAUTHENTICATED: The payment notification is not authentic.
SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: The subscription does not exist with the payment provider.
SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER_PLAN_MISMATCH: The subscription does not match the configured plan.
SUBSCRIPTION_QUERY_FAILED: The subscription could not be retrieved.
SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_VERIFICATION_FAILED: The payment notification could not be verified.
VALIDATION_SUBSCRIPTION_ID_INTEGER: The subscription ID must be an integer.
